event_summary: An orange spherical object enters from the left, moves rightward across the tabletop, and exits the right side while other visible objects remain stationary.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a light wood tabletop in front of a yellow sofa. A small two-toned object with an orange end and dark body lies near the rear upper-center of the table, and a black cylindrical object is partly visible at the far left edge. After several frames with no moving sphere visible, an orange sphere appears from the left side of the tabletop area, travels rightward across the table through the central region, approaches the right edge, and leaves the frame. The two-toned object, table, sofa, and partial black object do not visibly change position.

reasons: The tabletop and stationary objects are visible in the first frame.
The later moving orange sphere is not yet visible in the first frame.
